research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: ServiceTitan is researching systems and methods for digital catalog management, analyzing service job metrics to generate job allocations, and using machine learning for service metric prediction. Efforts also include dynamic pricing, automated generation of service item recommendations, adjustable work-flow capacity planning, and automated customer review matching. These areas reflect a focus on optimizing scheduling, pricing, resource allocation, and customer engagement in home service operations.
